name: 20th International Congress on Neuromuscular Diseases (ICNMD 2027)
description: ICNMD is a congress covering the full spectrum of neuromuscular disease research and clinical care. The 20th edition, in Chiba, Japan, is the first under the organizer's newly announced shift from a biennial to an annual schedule.

sources.note: Confirms 2027 dates (July 5-9), venue and full deadline schedule
Chiba Convention and Visitors Bureau announcement, states dates as July 6-10, 2027, one day later than icnmd.org
Confirms ICNMD is moving to an annual schedule starting in 2027
Confirms prior (19th) edition dates of July 7-11, 2026, already concluded before this data was compiled

notes: Discrepancy found: icnmd.org states July 5-9, 2027 while the Chiba Convention and Visitors Bureau news page states July 6-10, 2027. The organizer's own site was treated as authoritative, but this should be rechecked closer to the event.
